maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is asset management fees on institutional systematic investment strategies, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Clients are institutional investors such as pension funds, endowments and corporations paying management fees; mostly not government-paid.

serial_acquirer.reason: Formerly BrightSphere multi-affiliate holding company, now a single systematic manager growing organically via investment performance and client flows.

mission_critical.reason: Institutional clients can reallocate assets to other managers; switching involves some transition cost but no regulatory or operational lock-in.

notes: Some public pension clients exist, but the client base is mixed; switching is judged moderate.
